# truenas_cloudsync_credentials (Data Source)

Fetches TrueNAS cloud sync credentials by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the cloud sync credentials to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric cloud sync credentials ID.
- `provider_config` (String, Sensitive) JSON document of provider settings, as returned by the API.
